5. Covenant Conversations

Building Bridges.
Deepening Understanding.

Covenant Conversations is a permanent Jewish–Christian education and bridge-building platform within Faith Nexus.

14–16 April 2027 · Royal Majestic Hotel, Johannesburg
Context & Purpose

Why Covenant Conversations?

Christianity emerged from a Jewish historical, biblical and cultural context.

Yet misunderstanding, distance and misinformation continue to affect relationships between Jewish and Christian communities.

Covenant Conversations creates space for informed, respectful engagement that strengthens understanding rather than deepening division.

The platform brings together education, dialogue, leadership development, responsible media engagement and relationship-building.

Focus Areas

Areas of Engagement

  • • Jewish roots of Christianity
  • • Covenant and Scripture
  • • Jewish–Christian relations
  • • Faith, identity and public narratives
  • • Combating antisemitism and religious prejudice
  • • Responsible media engagement
  • • Youth and cultural exchange
Curated Tracks

Featured Programmes

Covenant Foundations

Education

Judaism Explained

Text & Context

Leadership

Building Jewish–Christian leadership relationships across Africa.

Media Training

Covenant Creators Lab

Training creators and media professionals to engage Jewish–Christian themes accurately and responsibly.

Next Generation

NextGen Covenant

Connecting emerging Jewish and Christian leaders through learning, dialogue and cultural exchange.

Long-term Vision

Beyond Faith Nexus 2027

Covenant Conversations will continue beyond the April summit. Educational programmes, leadership engagement and creator training will be developed as part of an ongoing platform for learning and relationship-building.
